title: DW3 port cards/<key>/card.json (cards-card-v1)
description: One new card of a content mod (the folder cards/<key>/ with card.json and an optional face.png of 32x32, 256 colours at most). Derived from pc/shim/card_ext.c (kCard, takeField, takeEffect) and content.c. The card.json the game exports for an original card (data/cards/c<nnn>/card.json) uses the same format name but is descriptive and never read.

name.description: Optional header: the folder's name, which is the card's key (the card is <mod folder>:<key>). The folder c<nnn> is an original card's art folder and is never a card.

base.description: The original card the entry starts from: dw3:card/<id> (1..314) or the number. Its stats, art and (cards 1..60) effect are copied.

title.description: The card's name per language folder: eng, fra, ita, ger, spa, es-419 (es-419 falls back to spa, then eng). eng is required.

description.description: Text per language folder: eng, fra, ita, ger, spa, es-419 (es-419 falls back to spa, then eng). eng is required for a name.

kind.description: An index of CARD_KINDS: 1..14 option cards, 16 a Digimon card.

points.description: What it adds to its colour.

price.description: What the card shop charges for one copy (0 is free). The shops only sell the card when a tables/card_shop_stock.json lists it; without a price it costs 1.

comboCard.description: The card three or more of it make; 0 for none.

effect.description: The effect of an option card: like (an original option card 1..60) first, then the fields override it.
